main_measure.name: mean unusual 5-bar move, mean_reversion cases minus trending cases
main_measure.threshold: confirm at Welch t <= -2 with the supporting check passing; reject at Welch t >= +2

supporting_check.name: same difference on cases with rise reading above pooled median, more negative than main

decided_by: Welch t <= -2 on the main difference and the above-median difference is more negative.
reading: The unusual move is the raw 5-bar return minus the coin's mean 5-bar grid return, not signed by the bet's direction (the plan compares returns across regimes), the case's regime is the bar's recorded regime, the first bet of each 5-bar grid cell is the case, and the plan's 30-case minimum per regime is applied as 'not observable'.
